payload.answer: src/components/AskAdam.tsx and src/components/layout/Footer.tsx are inside the 100% coverage include globs, so every new branch (variant wrapper/header/disabled notice, the Open-full-page link, surface param) needs both sides tested; src/app/chat/page.tsx is excluded from thresholds but still gets a colocated test for the heading, links and metadata (mock @/components/AskAdam); next.config.ts IS unit-tested: src/__tests__/next.config.test.ts imports the config, awaits rewrites()/redirects(), and asserts the four host rules exactly and that the three redirects come first. src/data/kb-sources.ts is covered by its existing tests under src/data/__tests__ — extend them for the new chunk. Tests stay colocated under __tests__/; never a root tests/ dir.
